title: Homogeneous linearly ordered spaces
summary: Every compact subset of a homogeneous generalized ordered (GO) space has character at most $ω_1$ and cardinality at most $2^{ω_1}$; if such a subset has uncountable character, then the character of the whole space equals $ω_1$ and its $π$-character is countable. We construct a homogeneous $σ$-compact linearly ordered space (LOTS) $\mathbf{H}$ containing a compact subset $\mathbf{S}$ of cardinality $2^{ω_1}$ whose character is $ω_1$ at every point and whose weight and Souslin number are both $2^{ω_1}$; thus both bounds obtained are sharp.
